We're rewriting the data pipeline and I want a second opinion on the design before I commit to it.

Currently everything runs as one nightly batch: extract from six source systems, land in S3, transform with a big Spark job, load into the warehouse. It takes about five hours and if any step fails we rerun the whole thing.

The proposal is to break it into per-source pipelines that can run and fail independently, with a coordination layer that only triggers downstream transforms when all upstream data for a date partition has landed.
